title: Label-budget curves under acquisition strategies (what to label next)
why: Tell the human exactly which labels cut OOD error fastest, quantified.
hypothesis: Diversity/coverage and new-factory breadth beat random; model-uncertainty sampling is anti-correlated with true OOD error (Z4).
data: 160 human OOD labels (138 good/22 bad, 47 factories) + frozen 26 per-pixel features; 1,546 unlabelled windows (same 47 factories)
method: 26-feature logistic, StratifiedGroupKFold(5, groups=factory), 5 acquisition strategies x k in {10,20,40,80,120}, paired vs random

title: Certification budget: labelled clusters for a false-accept bound
why: State the exact label budget that makes the review/error claim certifiable, not descriptive.
hypothesis: A cluster-Hoeffding/LTT bound at 95% confidence needs ~86 factories for r=0.20, ~342 for r=0.10, ~1365 for r=0.05; 47 today certifies only r~0.27.
data: 47 factories / 58 video clips / 1,546 unlabelled windows; Z2 conformal machinery
method: invert UCB = Rhat + sqrt(ln(1/delta')/(2K)) <= r, delta'=delta or delta/grid over the LTT grid

summary: Diversity/maximin is the best strategy at mid budget (k=80: error 0.257 vs random 0.338, -0.081 paired, better in 4/5 folds); breadth (one window per new factory) wins at low budget (k=20: 0.384 vs 0.421); depth (more windows per existing factory) is harmful early (+0.182 at k=40); uncertainty sampling is worst mid-budget (+0.063 at k=80, worse in 4/5 folds), confirming Z4 AUROC 0.349. n=160, n_bad=22 -> differences are suggestive, not significant.
decision: Label the top-200 diversity/balance list (eval/results/exp_acc/labels_next.json); do NOT label by model uncertainty.
cost: CPU only, ~2 min, no GPU, 160+1546 cached windows

summary: At 1-delta=0.95, certifying a marginal false-accept bound needs K factories: r=0.20 -> 86 (grid-union) / 38 (single threshold); r=0.10 -> 342 / 150; r=0.05 -> 1365 / 600. With 47 factories today the tightest certifiable r is ~0.27 (grid-union) / ~0.18 (single): a 5-10% bound is NOT certifiable. The current 'review 12%, FA 4%' point is descriptive. All 1,546 pool windows are in the same 47 factories, so the pool adds zero clusters; certification needs NEW factories.
decision: Open a data request for >=39 new factories (r=0.20); label the 200-window list for model error in the meantime.
